newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle sell $112/dressed, up $1 - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle sell $112/dressed, up $1 - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle near midday Tuesday sold at $112.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, up $1.00 from Monday's top, market sources said.
About 10,000 head sold in light to moderate trading, with a few sales also reported at $69.00 on a live basis. Live basis sales were up $1.00 from last week's top.
Most sales were in the western part of the state, they said. Western Nebraska was not hit as hard by last week's blizzard as other parts of the state, sources said.
Cold and snow in other areas reportedly set cattle rates of gain back three to five days, they said.
